rules.name_uniqueness: A variable name is unique within a service. Reuse across services is allowed only with the same semantic_id and meaning.
rules.secret_boundary: Secrets are server-only unless exposure is explicitly classified as public_configuration.
rules.runtime_mode_authority: APP_ENV is the only backend runtime-mode variable; DEBUG and ENVIRONMENT are retired.
rules.test_boundary: TEST_* variables are forbidden when APP_ENV=production.

variables.name: APP_ENV
variables.description: Selects development, test, or production safety behavior.

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: Platform-assigned HTTP listen port; Render injects it and operators must not duplicate it in service variables.

variables.name: RENDER_GIT_COMMIT
variables.description: Render-injected immutable Git commit for exact deployed-build evidence; application configuration must not override it.

variables.name: RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA
variables.description: Railway-injected immutable Git commit for exact deployed-build evidence; application configuration must not override it.

variables.name: DATABASE_URL
variables.description: PostgreSQL connection URL for the ERP transactional database; canonical production must authenticate exactly as the non-owner, non-superuser, non-BYPASSRLS erp_runtime role.
variables.format: postgresql URL with username erp_runtime in canonical production

variables.name: ERP_CALCULATOR_DATABASE_URL
variables.description: Dedicated server-only PostgreSQL URL authenticating exactly as erp_calculator for attested canonical calculation prepare transactions; never used by frontend, MCP, or ordinary API queries.

variables.name: TAX_PROVIDER_DATABASE_URL
variables.description: Dedicated server-only PostgreSQL URL authenticating exactly as erp_tax_provider for canonical e-invoice and e-way request reads and evidence completion commands.

variables.name: TAX_PROVIDER_INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN
variables.description: Independent server-only bearer secret authenticating the licensed tax-provider worker to the hidden canonical GST evidence boundary.
variables.format: high-entropy secret, minimum 32 bytes; distinct from every MCP and JWT secret

variables.name: TAX_PROVIDER_INTERNAL_HMAC_SECRET
variables.description: Independent server-only key signing exact timestamp, method, path, and raw body bytes for every hidden tax-provider worker request.
variables.format: high-entropy secret, minimum 32 bytes; distinct from bearer, MCP, and JWT secrets

variables.name: SUPABASE_URL
variables.description: Canonical HTTPS origin of the Supabase project used to verify browser authentication sessions.

variables.name: SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
variables.description: Supabase publishable anonymous key used only with user-scoped Auth APIs; it is not a service-role credential.

variables.name: EVIDENCE_STORAGE_ENABLED
variables.description: Fail-closed switch for canonical private PDF evidence upload; enable only after migration, bucket policy, restricted JWT and retention facts are verified.

variables.name: EVIDENCE_STORAGE_SERVER_JWT
variables.description: Server-only Supabase JWT whose role claim is exactly erp_evidence_storage and whose database authority is restricted to the canonical private evidence bucket; a service-role key is forbidden.

variables.name: JWT_SECRET_KEY
variables.description: Server-only key that signs short-lived ERP authorization tokens after verified Supabase session exchange.

variables.name: CORS_ORIGINS
variables.description: Comma-separated exact browser origins permitted to call the ERP API; wildcards are forbidden in production.

variables.name: APP_URL
variables.description: Canonical frontend origin used in email links and browser redirects.

variables.name: LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Minimum structured application log severity.

variables.name: LOG_FORMAT
variables.description: Log serialization format for operators and collectors.

variables.name: SMTP_HOST
variables.description: SMTP server hostname used only when transactional email delivery is enabled.

variables.name: SMTP_PORT
variables.description: SMTP submission port.

variables.name: SMTP_USER
variables.description: SMTP authentication username and default From address when SMTP_FROM_EMAIL is absent.

variables.name: SMTP_PASSWORD
variables.description: Server-only SMTP authentication password or application token.

variables.name: SMTP_FROM_EMAIL
variables.description: Verified sender address placed in outgoing ERP email headers.

variables.name: SMTP_FROM_NAME
variables.description: Human-readable sender name placed in outgoing ERP email headers.

variables.name: MCP_INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN
variables.description: Shared server-only secret authenticating the isolated MCP service to hidden ERP delegation endpoints; never an end-user bearer.

variables.name: MCP_OAUTH_PRE_REGISTERED_CLIENT_IDS
variables.description: Comma-separated reviewed OAuth client identifiers allowed to request ERP MCP delegation.

variables.name: TEST_MODE
variables.description: Enables bounded test-only dependency behavior and is rejected at production startup.

variables.name: TEST_ORG_ID
variables.description: Synthetic tenant identifier used only by test-mode organization context fixtures.

variables.name: TEST_BRANCH_ID
variables.description: Legacy positive-integer branch identifier used only by the noncanonical TEST_MODE OrgContext and legacy live_erp fixtures. Canonical fixture packs and canonical live tests use UUID branch IDs through PHARMA_CANONICAL_LIVE_TEST_BRANCH_ID instead.
variables.format: legacy positive integer; never a canonical branch UUID

variables.name: NODE_VERSION
variables.description: Node.js major version used for clean install, tests, and the Render static build; Supabase OAuth SDK support requires Node 22 or newer.

variables.name: NODE_ENV
variables.description: Create React App build mode supplied by the build toolchain; application code must not redefine it.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: Create React App public asset base supplied by the build toolchain for static asset URLs.

variables.name: RENDER_GIT_COMMIT
variables.description: Render-injected immutable Git commit written into build-metadata.json for exact static-build evidence.

variables.name: RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA
variables.description: Railway-injected immutable Git commit written into build-metadata.json for exact container-build evidence.

variables.name: REACT_APP_API_BASE_URL
variables.description: Browser-visible ERP API origin baked into the frontend build.

variables.name: REACT_APP_SUPABASE_URL
variables.description: Browser-visible canonical Supabase project origin used by the Auth client.

variables.name: REACT_APP_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
variables.description: Browser-visible Supabase publishable anonymous key; service-role keys are forbidden.

variables.name: REACT_APP_BUILD_NUMBER
variables.description: Non-secret build identifier shown in version diagnostics.

variables.name: REACT_APP_COMMIT_HASH
variables.description: Non-secret Git commit identifier shown in version diagnostics.

variables.name: REACT_APP_ENABLE_E2E_HARNESS
variables.description: Build-time switch exposing the bounded end-to-end harness; production builds must leave it false.

variables.name: SUPABASE_OAUTH_ISSUER
variables.description: Exact Supabase OAuth issuer accepted by the MCP resource server.

variables.name: MCP_RESOURCE_SERVER_URL
variables.description: Public canonical HTTPS URL of the Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint, including the /mcp suffix.

variables.name: ERP_API_BASE_URL
variables.description: Private-to-service ERP API origin used for hidden grant authorization and canonical reads.

variables.name: MCP_INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN
variables.description: Shared server-only secret proving calls originate from the isolated MCP service.

variables.name: MCP_OAUTH_PRE_REGISTERED_CLIENT_IDS
variables.description: Comma-separated reviewed OAuth clients accepted for MCP delegation; dynamic registration is disabled.

variables.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
variables.description: Optional comma-separated exact browser origins permitted to call the MCP service; wildcards and non-localhost HTTP origins are rejected.
variables.format: comma-separated HTTPS origins; localhost HTTP allowed for development

variables.name: MCP_BIND_HOST
variables.description: Local network interface on which the MCP ASGI process listens.

variables.name: MCP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
variables.description: Maximum duration for one MCP-to-ERP HTTP request.

variables.name: RENDER_GIT_COMMIT
variables.description: Render-injected immutable Git commit returned by MCP health for exact deployed-build evidence.

variables.name: RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA
variables.description: Railway-injected immutable Git commit returned by MCP health for exact deployed-build evidence.
